title: SimulationResultV1
description: Versioned, source-agnostic data contract for a single DMAAST value-chain digital-twin demo simulation run. Single source of truth for both the KAM and JPB twins and for the smap UI. The `result` payload is the normalized form of the twin's `/api/demo/simulate` response (which the twin emits as separate top-level `*_events` arrays + `hierarchy_summary`); the SimSource adapter re-shapes it into this envelope. Twin-specific / product-specific asymmetry (KAM single-product vs JPB multi-product catalog, extra planning/shock knobs, extra event columns, per-product dynamic timeseries columns) is carried in the OPTIONAL `config` block and via open object shapes (additionalProperties:true) on kpis / event rows / hierarchy. The normalized top-level shape (kpis, timeseries, events, hierarchy) is symmetric across both twins.

contract_version.description: SemVer of this contract. Consumers MUST check the major version.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp the artifact was produced (pre-generated source only).

source.description: Provenance. 'pre-generated' = static artifact exported from a one-shot twin run (phase B). 'live' = fetched from the twin's POST /api/demo/simulate at runtime (phase A, future). The SimSource adapter interface is identical for both.

company.description: Role/use-case key. Matches smap CompanyContext.Company; drives role-based ('kam'|'jpb') artifact loading.

config.description: OPTIONAL. The resolved run configuration. Present in artifacts for traceability and to carry KAM/JPB asymmetry without changing the symmetric result shape. Absent/partial `config` is valid.

product_id.description: Finished-good id. KAM: fixed 021XBXXXXXXF04. JPB: catalog base product (pilot ST5253-06 when config_code is null).

config_code.description: JPB catalog selector; null for the pilot/default product and always null for KAM (single product).

supports_configurations.description: true only for JPB (LULYLOK multi-product catalog). false for KAM. Drives whether a product picker is meaningful.

demand_mode.description: One of family_proxy | exact_f04 | family_scaled. Twin default differs: KAM family_scaled, JPB family_proxy.

planning.description: PlanningConfig used. Core keys shared by both twins; JPB adds max_batch_qty, ship_complete, reorder_on_position, leaf_coverage_factor, sa_coverage_factor.

shocks.description: Global ShockConfig used (all zero for the baseline default scenario). JPB adds Subcontract_Lead_Time_pct, Rework_pct, Quality_Hold_pct.

result.description: The normalized simulation output. Symmetric across twins at this level.

kpis.description: Scalar summary metrics. Open shape (twins may add keys, e.g. JPB adds `company`). Core keys below are present in both twins.

timeseries.description: Inventory snapshot per tick (0.25-day step). Besides the fixed columns, each row carries one dynamic `inv_<subAssemblyId>` column per sub-assembly (product-specific — this is why additionalProperties is true).

events.description: Discrete-event logs grouped by kind. Maps the twin's separate top-level arrays: demand_events, production_events, shipment_events, level_events, replenishment_events. Rows are open objects — JPB carries extra columns (shipment: order_qty/is_partial; replenishment: trigger/quality_hold_days) and KAM assembly-phase level rows carry extra columns.

level.description: Per-level procurement/assembly events. `phase` is 'procurement' | 'assembly'. `parts_detail` is a nested array of component rows.

hierarchy.description: BOM / value-chain tree summary (the twin's `hierarchy_summary`). Drives the hierarchy tab.

assembly_plan_order.description: Parent part numbers in bottom-up assembly order.

levels.description: Per-parent-part level summary keyed by part number.

by_part.description: Per-part aggregates (produced/consumed/ending_inventory/...) keyed by part number, for node badges.
